title: Omukkiriza Omukwese
intro: Mu bisenge eby’amaanyi eby’obuyinza, awaali obutakkiriza n’obutyobooli, eddoboozi ery’amazima eryali lyokka lyayogera okuva mu kifo kye baali batasuubira. Omuwendo guno gwasomooza ab’obuyinza okukuuma omubaka, ne bateeka obukuumi bwabwe mu kabi okulangirira amazima.
clues: Nnali mbeera mu nsi ey’obukambwe obw’amaanyi, nga mpeereza omufuzi eyeeyita Katonda.
Enzikiriza zange entuufu nnazikweka okumala emyaka mingi, nga ntya ebiyinza okuva mu kuzibikkula.
Omubaka bwe yajja ng’alina obubonero obw’olwatu, nnakkiriza, naye abantu bange ne bamwekobaana.
Nayimirira mu maaso g’omutyobooli n’olukiiko lwe, nga njogera nti tebalina kutta mubaka atalina musango.
Nabalabula ku kibonerezo ky’amawanga ag’emabega agaana amazima, ng’abantu ba Nuuwa ne ‘Ad.
Allah yamponya enkwe zaabwe embi, era nalaba okuzikirizibwa kw’obufuzi obunyigiriza.

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Yawonyezebwa okuva mu bulabe ng’ate abanyigiriza bazikirizibwa
Yasuuliddwa mu muliro n’avaayo nga tafunye buzibu
Yataayaaya mu ddungu okumala emyaka amakumi ana
outcome.answer: Yawonyezebwa okuva mu bulabe ng’ate abanyigiriza bazikirizibwa

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
